source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi,

Thanks for getting back to me.

What I need is someone to take the existing report and turn it into a polished, premium, editable report template that feels like a professional paid assessment.

The current report already exists, so this is not a full copywriting project. The main work is improving the design, layout, structure, and editability.

The key things I need are:

\- A stronger front page

I want the first page to include a prominent score/dashboard panel that shows the customer's vehicle security score, risk band, exposure level, priority level, main reason for the rating, and primary weaknesses. The customer should immediately understand their result upon opening the report.

\- Consistent header and footer

The report should have a clean, consistent header and footer across all pages. This should include details such as the report name, report ID, vehicle group, confidential/restricted status, assessment date, and page number.

\- Scoring summary section

I need a clear scoring table showing the main scoring categories, the maximum score, the customer score, and the total score. This needs to make the assessment feel more transparent and professional.

\- Recommended upgrade path

The recommendations should be presented clearly, ideally in order of priority, such as immediate actions, priority upgrades, and secondary upgrades. The report needs to feel practical and action-led, not just informational.

\- Editable templates

This is very important. I need the final report files to be editable so I can update them for different customers. I need to be able to change details such as vehicle registration, assessment date, report ID, vehicle group, security score, risk band, category scores, weaknesses, recommendations, and customer-specific notes.

\- Multiple report versions

I want editable versions of the report templates for RR01, RR02, RR03, and RR04 so that I can select the appropriate template based on the customer's score/risk level.

The final files need to be easy for me to edit and export as a PDF. Canva or PowerPoint may be best, but I'm open to your recommendation if you think another format would be more suitable.

Please can you let me know:

\- Whether this is the type of project you can help with
\- What file format you would recommend
\- What you would need from me before starting
\- Estimated cost
\- Estimated timescale

Whether the final files would include all fonts, icons and design assets needed for future editing
I can send over the existing sample report and any reference images once I know this is a good fit.

Thanks
